name: Unnamed Project

entity_types.name: Politician
entity_types.description: Elected officials, candidates, or political leaders involved in Thai or Cambodian governance.

attributes.name: full_name_en
attributes.description: The full name of the politician in English

attributes.name: political_affiliation
attributes.description: The political party or movement they belong to

attributes.name: current_role
attributes.description: Current official position or title

entity_types.name: Diplomat
entity_types.description: Official representatives of a country involved in international relations and negotiations.

attributes.name: full_name_en
attributes.description: The full name of the diplomat

attributes.name: representing_country
attributes.description: The country the diplomat represents

attributes.name: diplomatic_rank
attributes.description: The rank such as Ambassador or Consul General

entity_types.name: PoliticalParty
entity_types.description: Organized groups that seek to influence government policy and contest elections.

attributes.name: party_name_en
attributes.description: Official name of the political party

attributes.name: ideology
attributes.description: The primary political stance of the party

attributes.name: headquarters_location
attributes.description: City where the party is based

entity_types.name: MilitaryOfficial
entity_types.description: High-ranking officers in the armed forces who influence national security and politics.

attributes.name: full_name_en
attributes.description: The full name of the military officer

attributes.name: military_branch
attributes.description: The branch of service, e.g., Royal Thai Army

attributes.name: rank_title
attributes.description: The military rank held

entity_types.name: Activist
entity_types.description: Individuals leading social or political movements, often organizing protests or campaigns.

attributes.name: full_name_en
attributes.description: The full name of the activist

attributes.name: cause_area
attributes.description: The primary issue they advocate for, e.g., Democracy, Border Rights

attributes.name: social_media_handle
attributes.description: Primary account handle used for public communication

entity_types.name: MediaOutlet
entity_types.description: News organizations, digital publishers, or broadcasting agencies reporting on politics.

attributes.name: outlet_name_en
attributes.description: The name of the media organization

attributes.name: media_type
attributes.description: Format of the media, e.g., Digital News, TV, Newspaper

attributes.name: editorial_stance
attributes.description: General political leaning or focus of the outlet

entity_types.name: GovernmentAgency
entity_types.description: State institutions responsible for specific administrative functions like foreign affairs.

attributes.name: agency_name_en
attributes.description: Official name of the government department

attributes.name: jurisdiction_area
attributes.description: The functional area of responsibility

attributes.name: official_website
attributes.description: The primary online portal for the agency

entity_types.name: ThinkTank
entity_types.description: Research institutes or academic groups that provide analysis on geopolitics and policy.

attributes.name: institution_name_en
attributes.description: The name of the research institution

attributes.name: research_focus
attributes.description: The primary area of study, e.g., ASEAN Geopolitics

attributes.name: base_country
attributes.description: The country where the think tank is headquartered

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: Fallback type for any natural person not fitting specific categories, such as netizens or experts.

attributes.name: full_name_en
attributes.description: Full name of the individual

attributes.name: biography_snippet
attributes.description: Short description of the person's background

attributes.name: nationality
attributes.description: The country of citizenship

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Fallback type for any group, association, or entity not fitting specific categories.

attributes.name: org_name_en
attributes.description: The name of the organization

attributes.name: industry_sector
attributes.description: The sector the organization operates in

attributes.name: mission_statement
attributes.description: The primary goal or purpose of the group

edge_types.name: CRITICIZES
edge_types.description: Expresses disapproval or points out faults in another entity's actions or policies.

edge_types.name: NEGOTIATES_WITH
edge_types.description: Engages in formal discussions to resolve frictions or reach agreements.

edge_types.name: REPORTS_ON
edge_types.description: Provides news coverage or analysis regarding the activities of an entity.

edge_types.name: MEMBER_OF
edge_types.description: Indicates formal membership or affiliation with a group or party.

edge_types.name: PROTESTS_AGAINST
edge_types.description: Publicly demonstrates opposition to an entity or its policies.

edge_types.name: ALLIED_WITH
edge_types.description: Formally or informally cooperates with another entity for mutual benefit.

edge_types.name: ADVISES
edge_types.description: Provides expert recommendations or policy guidance to an entity.

analysis_summary: The ontology is designed to simulate the complex geopolitical and domestic political landscape of Thailand and Cambodia in 2026. It focuses on key actors such as politicians, military officials, and diplomats who drive international relations, while including activists and media outlets to capture the spread of public opinion and social friction. Fallback types ensure all social media participants can be mapped.
simulation_requirement: find info from the real world to simulate and predict thai politics 2026
